ct26b: SMAT 2026/27 most runs as of 20 Nov 2026 (CricTracker)
ct26w: SMAT 2026/27 most wickets as of 20 Nov 2026 (CricTracker)
sdun: SMAT players to watch for IPL 2027 (SportsDunia)

components.S: Overall skill: run value per ball against expectation (game state, ground, season and the strength of the opposition), SMAT 2015/16-2024/25, shrunk towards average for small samples
components.P: Pressure skill: run value and win probability added on pressure balls (the 20% of balls that can swing a game most)
components.R: Role fit: run value in the phases the board pick is bought for (openers: powerplay; finishers and death bowlers: overs 16-20; spinners: overs 7-15)
components.F: Current form: SMAT 2025/26 and 2026/27 (to 20 Nov 2026), runs per game x strike rate or wickets per game x economy, ranked within each season (55-100; Plate group -20); 35 if not among the leaders
components.D: Dependability: SMAT games since 2021/22 plus 2025-27 games

method.opposition: Every ball is weighted by the strength of the opposition (a rating of all 38 sides from run-rate margins, opponent-adjusted, 2015/16-2024/25): balls against below-average sides count less, down to 15% against the weakest; expectations also adjust for each opponent team-season
filters: no IPL 2027 contract (all ten retention lists, 17 Nov 2026)
not a veteran: not playing the SMAT in 2015/16 and not aged 33+
active since 2022/23 or in the 2025-27 form lists
same role (batting slot) or same bowling type (pace/spin) as the board pick

windows: data to 2018/19, form 2019/20, judged on pressure balls 2020/21 onwards
data to 2019/20, form 2020/21, judged on pressure balls 2021/22 onwards
data to 2018/19, form 2019/20, judged on pressure balls 2020/21 onwards
data to 2019/20, form 2020/21, judged on pressure balls 2021/22 onwards
